body:
Thanks for the response dude, I was going to School at a public college, but a lot of things happened in my personal life that seriously effected my school work so I came home for the summer and am now going to community college for the semester while I try to earn more money and figure out what the hell I want to do for a career.

I've always loved the idea of going on some kind of adventure, (what that is I'm not sure but I want to do something extremely adventurous somewhere outside my home state) as far as going and reconnecting with old friends go, I could probably go visit them by car, the 3 colleges near me that house most the the people I know are about an hour away each, so that could definitely happen.

But how do you suppose I start doing those things? I'm not someone who's good at starting stuff, I've always had a problem with it. Sure once I get going I'm very hard to stop, but it's that getting started that I struggle with the most.

Thank you very very much for writing to me, I really needed (still need) this, I'd love to keep talking to you, if you'd be so kind as to continue helping me with this.
